clips.title: The story
paras: Following the settling of Coleman Farthing's personal score at Agamand Mills, Magistrate Sevren summons the adventurer to Brill. The mills house far more than bitter family ghosts; they represent an active Scourge peril on the settlement's northern border.

Coleman Farthing sought personal retribution against his former neighbors, the Agamands, sending travelers north to tear through the undead lurking about the flour mills. Once those remains were delivered, Coleman recognized that his private grudge intersected with a wider tactical problem: the entire Agamand estate remains swarming with mindlessly aggressive Scourge minions right on Brill's doorstep.

Magistrate Sevren oversees civic and military security in Brill for the Dark Lady. Impressed by reports of an adventurer capable of surviving deep incursions into the haunted farmlands, Sevren steps in to direct those capable hands toward the root of the infestation—the ancient Agamand family crypt itself.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge. But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.
I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Coleman speaks well of you, friend, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.
The Forsaken have need of your talents once again...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
